properties.name: Sukhumvit Road Flood Corridor
properties.name_th: ถนนสุขุมวิท พัทยากลาง-พัทยาใต้
properties.description: Severe road basin underpass between Central and South Pattaya Sukhumvit. Impassable for small motorbikes & sedans during flash rain.

properties.name: Railway Bypass Road (Liap Thang Rotfai)
properties.name_th: ถนนเลียบทางรถไฟ พัทยา
properties.description: Low-lying drainage canal overflow. Water sweeps rapidly across the road from East Pattaya hills toward the coast.

properties.name: Third Road & Soi Buakhao Basin
properties.name_th: ถนนสาย 3 และ ซอยบัวขาว (ทรีทาวน์)
properties.description: Natural depression near Tree Town & Chalermphrakiat Soi 21. Water backs up rapidly within 20 mins of heavy rain.

properties.name: South Beach Road & Walking Street Entry
properties.name_th: ถนนเลียบชายหาดตอนใต้ - ทางเข้าวอล์คกิ้งสตรีท
properties.description: Stormwater runoff meets high tide near Bali Hai / Walking Street entrance. Sandbags deployed during monsoons.
